summary: Introduces some Forward Error Correction (FEC) schemes that supplement RFC 3452. They use a more compact FEC Payload ID for reliable bulk delivery of large objects, and can send blocks of an object of indeterminate length in sequence. It is experimental and has been replaced by RFC 5445.

eli5.summary: When you send puzzle pieces, some get lost. Extra spare pieces let the receiver rebuild the picture without asking again. This describes shorter labels for the pieces. RFC 5445 replaced it.

questions: what is forward error correction in bulk delivery
